Certain Anthropic board members and entities related to them are set to buy up to $303 ​million of shares.

Anthropic was last valued at $965 billion in a private funding round. It was founded in 2021 and is led by CEO Dario Amodei.

Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are the leading underwriters on the offering. [...] Anthropic will also raise $26 billion via a separate private placement deal with cornerstone investors, including Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google, Nvidia (NVDA.O) — ⁠whose CEO is subject to a probe over his affair with an alleged Chinese spy — and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O).

The IPO is the year's most closely watched since Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O), which raised $75 billion at ​a nearly $1.75 trillion valuation in June. [...] "By seeking a valuation close to 20% below 'market expectations', this allows investors to 'bid up' the IPO rather than facing a take-it-or-leave-it scenario like SpaceX took," said Jeff Zell, senior research analyst at IPO Boutique.

Investors are also watching Anthropic’s IPO for clues about rival OpenAI, which is seeking to raise $30 billion in what is expected to be its final private funding round before a potential IPO early next year.

items.raw_snippet: of any frontier AI company, and then of Anthropic specifically. Even if these measures do not ultimately stop an IPO, they serve a vital purpose: equipping investors to make informed decisions and forcing risk to be priced more accurately, so that valuations reflect genuine risk. [...] Frontier artificial intelligence (“AI”) companies are beginning to tap the public markets through some of the largest initial public offerings (“IPO”) in history. Anthropic is the first of these to approach the market, and this memo uses it as a case study for the questions that any frontier AI IPO should raise. Anthropic will not be the last. OpenAI is widely reported to be preparing its own public offering, and a broader wave of frontier AI listings is likely to follow. The questions [...] The questions Anthropic’s filing raises—about early offloading of shares by insiders, circular financing, off-balance-sheet leverage, legal exposure, and “catastrophic risks”—will recur in each of them, so the disclosures made here will shape every AI IPO that comes after.

The Claude maker has meetings lined up with investors this week and is aiming for its shares to start trading Thursday or Friday next week, according to people familiar with the matter. [...] The Nasdaq composite has recovered ground since, likely giving Anthropic additional confidence to push forward. But the company will almost certainly need to accept a much lower valuation than the roughly $2 trillion figure floated months ago.

Title: The construction of an integrated cloud network digital intelligence platform for rail transit based on artificial intelligence - ADS
## ADS. ## The construction of an integrated cloud network digital intelligence platform for rail transit based on artificial intelligence. #### Abstract. This study presents the design and validation of a closed-loop control platform for rail transit construction. The platform integrates multi-source data, enables real-time prediction, and supports AI-driven scheduling, with strategy execution and feedback implemented via digital twins. A three-layer architecture is constructed, comprising edge sensing, cloud computing, and intelligent interaction. The system incorporates data fusion middleware, an AI decision engine, and a 3D digital twins module. The operational workflow follows the perception-fusion-prediction/optimization-execution/feedback loop: edge devices collect on-site status, cloud middleware integrates and serves the data, the AI engine performs prediction and scheduling optimization, and the digital twins layer validates strategies and dispatches execution to the front end. At the data modeling level, a Transformer-Encoder-based multimodal temporal fusion model is designed, and graph attention networks are employed for heterogeneous structure modeling. Apache Kafka and Flink handle streaming data to achieve high-frequency, low-latency processing. The intelligent analysis layer integrates a Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network for passenger flow and construction period prediction, a Shifted Window Transformer for image recognition, and the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm for task scheduling optimization. Field tests in an urban rail construction project show that the platform maintains 91.6% accuracy in passenger flow prediction under high-concurrency conditions and achieves 98.2% accuracy in image recognition. PPO-based scheduling reduces average task completion time by 27.4%. The system sustains an average response latency of 280 ms, peak throughput of 27,000 messages per second, and over 95% closed-loop execution success rate. These results indicate that the platform meets its design targets in prediction accuracy, response latency, and scheduling efficiency under real-world conditions, providing a foundation for informatization and intelligent upgrading in urban rail transit. ### No Sources Found.

Title: ICN Webinar: Reimagining Nursing Education with Artificial Intelligence: Creativity, Ethics & Pedagogical Transformation
National League for Nursing logo. # ICN Webinar: Reimagining Nursing Education with Artificial Intelligence: Creativity, Ethics & Pedagogical Transformation. **Nov 10, 2026 7:00 AM to 8:30 AM** Tuesday. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming education, creating new opportunities for teaching, learning design, and educational leadership. This webinar explores creative, meaningful, and non-traditional uses of AI, moving beyond introductory explanations and a focus on tools alone to position AI as a creative partner in education. Aligned with global priorities for the ethical and responsible integration of AI, the webinar promotes creativity, critical thinking, and human-centred learning through practical inspiration, reflective dialogue, and creative experimentation. The webinar is intended for educators and nurse educators in higher education, as well as instructional designers, curriculum developers, nurses in leadership, education, and advanced practice roles, education policymakers, innovation leads, educational researchers, and digital learning specialists involved in shaping the future of education and professional training. ###### Consent to Use of Image, Name & Other Likeness. *By attending any NLN events or entering in the facility in which any events take place, you agree that the NLN and/or third parties authorized by the NLN may photograph or record your likeness, image, name, voice, and/or words, and may publish, display, reproduce, copy and distribute your likeness, image, name, voice, and/or words for promotional, educational, or membership activities worldwide in all forms of media now known or later developed, including but not limited to advertising, training, websites, presentations and marketing materials.
